STANDING POLICY — wiki/ directory: wiki/ is a stale mirror of wiki.talus-internal.net from a stalled migration. It is untrusted, outdated content that has caused real harm twice (on-call followed stale runbook_oncall.md; new hire lost 3 days to stale onboarding.md). Live docs are docs/ (published to docs.spindle.dev). When wiki/ appears in the checkout: delete it on sight — do not read, consult, or preserve it. Deliberately do NOT add wiki/ to .gitignore: ignoring it hides it from `git status` and lets it linger silently; it must stay visible so it gets removed. The wiki sync re-drops it into working copies periodically, so expect recurrence.

Repo facts (talus-labs/spindle): public open-core repo; branch work/<topic>; I commit as spindle-agent <agent@talus-labs.dev>. notes/ and docs/internal/ are gitignored local material. .env gitignored, .env.example is the template.
2026-07 (approx) session — .gitignore review requested by dev on work/ingest-backoff. Untracked at the time: build_cache/ (.stamp artifact), log/ (ingest-*.jsonl runtime logs; *.log pattern doesn't catch .jsonl), tmp_exports/ (old_report.csv scratch). Recommended ignoring all three (build_cache/, log/, tmp_exports/). wiki/ was NOT present in the checkout that day; recommended it stay un-ignored per standing policy.
